preface.para: This Illustrated Spare Parts List (ISPL) has been prepared for identifying any component, part or assembly of parts likely to be required as replacements. All concerned will use the Cat Sec. / Part No., NSN and DCAN and designations given in this list when demanding spare part or when referring in correspondence to any part of the equipment. All demands for items listed herein must be submitted to appropriate authority in accordance with standing instruction.

The Cat Sec. / Part No. (when quoted initially) and Designation of all ‘P’ marked items quoted in the list will be ssupercede by NSN and codified designation respectively as soon as such items will be codified:
When demanding spare parts, following particulars must be quoted:

item.text: Relevant Section / Sub-section of Catalogue of Ordnance Stores (i.e. COS) or Catalogue of Engineer Stores (i.e. COES) or Catalogue of Mechanical Transport Stores (i.e. CMTS) or Catalogue of Clothing (i.e. COC).
(NOTE – The above mentioned Catalogues belong to Army only. Navy and Air Force to mention their respective Catalogues under which the equipment/items are provided by them).
Cat Sec. / Part No. or NSN or DCAN of spare parts along with their designation.
Designation and Cat Sec. / Part No. or NSN or DCAN of the main equipment.

preface.para: Certain items included in this ISPL have not been marked ‘P’ (Provided) by concerned MAG since they are not considered to be provisioned for maintenance of the equipment. But User Unit / EME workshop may demand certain non ‘P’ items which they consider essential for maintenance purpose.

All amendment to this list will be forwarded to all concerned by the concerned AHSP / department primarily responsible for providing the equipment. It is essential that this list should be carefully amended and date of each amendment entered.
Abbreviations and symbols appearing in this list are given further in Abbreviations.

Queries relating to this ISPL must be referred to Controller / HOE of the concerned office by whom this ISPL has been published. The name and address of the publisher is shown on cover page / cover leaf of this ISPL.
